Serving-endpoint spec that enables the AI Gateway inference table via AUTO-CAPTURE (ai_gateway.inference_table_config). This is the classic serving-endpoint form of the gateway; the deployed Volta gateway uses the newer AI Gateway *model service* (see ../gateway_service.txt), which enables the same inference-table auto-capture via config.inference_table. Deploy with: databricks serving-endpoints create --json @serving_endpoint_ai_gateway.json --profile

. The external_model proxies databricks-gpt-5-4 via an OpenAI-compatible base using a secret-scoped token (never inline).
name: volta-gpt-gateway-endpoint
